app_store.name: ZenStream: Calm Cinema
app_store.subtitle: Stream movies without noise
app_store.promotional_text: Stream hundreds of acclaimed films peacefully. Zero blaring autoplay trailers, zero intrusive popups over end credits, and full respect for your evening.
app_store.description:
ZenStream is the streaming platform for viewers who value peace over noise.

Most video services treat your screen like an attention-seeking casino: hovering over a title launches blaring audio, and end credits get cut off by aggressive countdown timers. ZenStream does the opposite.

What makes ZenStream different:
- Silent Browsing: No video or audio trailer plays unless you click play.
- Respect for the Film: End credits roll naturally with the composer's complete score. No countdown popup.
- Dialogue Clarity Boost: Intelligent speech normalization clarifies whisper dialogue and softens loud sound effects.
- Hide What You Dislike: Click Hide on any title to permanently remove it from your recommendations.
- True Stream Portability: Watch simultaneously on any device anywhere in the world. No household geofencing locks.

Simple, transparent subscription pricing. 14-day free trial on all plans.
app_store.whats_new: Welcome to ZenStream. Introducing calm browsing with zero uninvited video autoplays and dialogue speech boost.
